context: Tests whether the agent executes the promptify workflow end-to-end: records a structured request analysis, picks a defensible documented pattern for a code-security-review request, and authors a complete prompt that a team could use unchanged (role assignment, concrete instructions, output format, constraints, verifiable quality criteria).

checklist.name: Analysis file present
checklist.description: analysis.md exists and contains a Purpose field describing what the AI should accomplish.

checklist.name: Analysis covers inputs and outputs
checklist.description: analysis.md states the Input (a Go source file) and the Output (a structured vulnerability report).

checklist.name: Analysis names a documented pattern
checklist.description: analysis.md picks exactly one of the documented patterns (Role-Based, Task-Oriented, Few-Shot Learning, Chain-of-Thought, Structured Output) and briefly justifies it.

checklist.name: Generated prompt file present
checklist.description: generated-prompt.md exists and contains a complete prompt, not notes about a prompt.

checklist.name: Prompt assigns a specific role
checklist.description: The prompt opens with a specific expert role/identity (e.g. 'You are a security engineer specialising in Go'), not a generic instruction.

checklist.name: Prompt instructions are specific
checklist.description: The instructions name the concrete vulnerability classes to analyse (e.g. authentication, authorization, input validation, data handling) or equivalent specific scope, not generic 'find bugs'.

checklist.name: Prompt defines output format
checklist.description: The prompt specifies an exact output format (e.g. markdown with severity/location/description/fix fields) the reviewing agent must follow.

checklist.name: Prompt has constraints or quality criteria
checklist.description: The prompt includes constraints (what NOT to do, boundaries) or explicit quality criteria for the report.

checklist.name: No vague quality words
checklist.description: The prompt does not use unqualified vague words like 'good', 'better', 'properly' without definition.
